raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview When a chat message carries its content as a list of blocks, the Rust DeepSeek V4 renderer concatenates the text blocks with no separator, and V4.1 concatenates assistant text blocks. The reference implementation, [deepseek-ai/deepseek-recipe](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-recipe), joins the content blocks of every role with `"\n\n"` for both V4 and V4.1. This PR does the same in the Rust renderer. ## Claims - V4 and V4.1 join list-form content blocks with a blank line for system, user, developer, assistant and tool-result messages, matching deepseek-recipe. - String content, and list content with a single block, render exactly as before. ## Validation Commands from `.buildkite/scripts/run-rust-frontend-cargo-ci.sh` (`style-clippy` and `test`), run from the repo root: ``` cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check # ok cargo sort --workspace --check rust # ok cargo deny --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --config rust/deny.toml check bans # ok cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings # ok cargo nextest run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-features --locked --no-fail-fast # 2312 tests run: 2312 passed, 13 skipped ``` - `deepseek_v4::tests::content_parts_are_joined_by_a_blank_line_for_every_role`: two-block system, user, assistant (text plus a tool call), tool-result and follow-up user content. The snapshot matches what the recipe produces for the same messages. - `deepseek_v41::tests::joins_assistant_text_parts_with_reference_separator`: assistant text blocks on V4.1. - Both fail with the `deepseek.rs` change reverted. ## Details Reference behavior (deepseek-recipe `935817c66f`): `ChatCompletionRequestContent::into_content` (`deepseek-recipe/src/protocol/openai/chat_completion/request/convert.rs:291-357`) maps each text block to its text and each image block to the image token, then returns `Prompt::join(&contents, "\n\n")`. `transform_messages` uses it for system, user, assistant and tool-result messages, and the V4/V4.1 encoders insert the joined content as is (`push_assistant_content`, `{content}`). The encoders' blank line between separate messages is already handled in Rust and unchanged. Changes, all in `rust/src/chat/src/renderer/deepseek.rs` (shared by V4 and V4.1): - `write_chat_content` inserts `"\n\n"` between content parts for both dialects; before, only V4.1 did. V4 image parts still return the existing unsupported-multimodal 400. - `write_assistant_text` joins assistant text blocks with `"\n\n"` for both dialects. The server lowers each text part of an assistant message into its own `AssistantContentBlock::Text`, so this is where the recipe's assistant join belongs. Block flattening is a model-template concern, so the fix stays in the model renderer rather than in shared request preparation. The V3.2 encoder has its own `write_assistant_text` and is not affected. Difference from the Python renderer: Python's `parse_chat_messages` flattens text-only tool-result content with a single newline before encoding. This PR follows the recipe (a blank line) instead. Not a duplicate: open DeepSeek V4 renderer PRs (vllm-project/vllm#62189, vllm-project/vllm#63497) change turn structure and developer instructions, not content-block joining. AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to prepare this change; the human submitter reviewed every changed line. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01K2SEJPm2Mawmm6pu8m9E1o ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
